The domestic currency climbed 10 paise to close at 93.41 against US dollar on Wednesday after gaining 68 paise in the preceding two sessions.

title: India bonds hold on to opening gains; moves in crude, Treasuries to stay main trigger
excerpt: Indian government bonds have seen an uptick, supported by international buying activity, boosting bond prices positively. Early trading sessions showed minor fluctuations in the benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield. Meanwhile, US Treasury yields stabilized after recent volatility. Crude oil prices held firm, shaped by global supply and demand trends. Anticipation grows in Indian markets for a possible rate hike from the Reserve Bank of India in December.

title: Finances of Panchayati Raj Institutions
excerpt:
Today, the Reserve Bank released the second edition of its biennial Report titled “ Finances of Panchayati Raj Institutions ”. The theme of this edition is ‘Local Finances and Capacity Building in Rural India’. Drawing upon a balanced panel of 2.25 lakh Gram Panchayats for the period 2022-23 to 2024-25, the Report presents an assessment of their finances and their role in achieving sustainable and inclusive rural socio-economic development.
Highlights:
Gram Panchayat finances strengthened during 2022-23 and 2023-24; they, however, remain dependent on intergovernmental transfers, accounting for about 90 per cent of total receipts, while own source revenues (OSR) accounted for a modest share…

title: Sebi roadmap focuses on faster IPOs, easier foreign investor access: Official
excerpt: Sebi is focusing on streamlining IPO and rights issue timelines to improve market efficiency. The regulator aims to reduce friction across the capital-raising lifecycle for economic expansion. Additionally, Sebi is working on enhancing corporate bond markets and expanding financing sources. It is also reforming municipal bond issuances to encourage urban infrastructure financing. With these changes, Sebi anticipates significantly mobilizing both domestic and global savings for inclusive wealth creation.
